title: Mnesis objects.jsonl object-track side channel (C13)
description: One line of the objects.jsonl side channel produced alongside a capture's frame-level JSONL (Video2Robo trajectory pipeline, Mnesis-Daedalus scene/object_track.py). The file is additive-only: it never modifies the frame-level JSONL, and a consumer that does not know about it can ignore it entirely. The first line is a 'header' object; every subsequent line is an 'object' observation. This schema validates ONE line at a time — the cross-line invariants (frame line's header.pose_dof matching every object row, frame numbers non-decreasing, distinct track_id count matching header.num_tracks) are NOT expressible per-line and are enforced by mnesis_canonical.objects_jsonl.validate_objects_jsonl_stream instead. Authority: CONTRACTS.md C13. Keep in lock-step with mnesis_canonical/objects_jsonl.py.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Only 1 is currently defined.

source.description: Producing module, e.g. 'lerobot.scene.object_track'. Provenance, not a contract switch.

frame_dialect.description: Which frames_dir layout the tracks were extracted from — 'mono' (scene/capture.py, shared intrinsics.npy) or 'iris' (scene/iris_bridge.py, per-frame depth/intrinsics). Informational: does not change how objects.jsonl itself is read.

detector_backend.description: 2-D detector backend that produced the boxes (e.g. 'onnx_cpu', 'remote', or a test stub name). Open value set — detector backends are swappable by design (lerobot.perception.detector.Detector).

pose_frame.description: Frame every object_record.position_m is expressed in. Only 'map' is defined today — a record in a sensor- or headset-local frame is not fusable, same discipline as C12's ObservationLabel.frame_id.

pose_dof.description: Degrees of freedom this file's records actually carry. MUST equal every object_record.pose_dof in the file — a per-record override is a producer bug, not a per-object feature. See object_record.pose_dof for the honesty rule this field exists to enforce.

num_frames.description: Number of frames_dir frames the extraction walked.

num_tracks.description: Number of distinct track_id values that appear anywhere in this file's object records.

object_record.title: objects.jsonl object observation (every line after the header)

frame.description: Index into the source frames_dir this observation came from.

track_id.description: Cross-frame track identifier assigned by the extractor's associator. Stable across frames for the same physical object within one file; not a canonical taxonomy value.

class_id.description: Open-vocabulary object class label straight from the 2-D detector backend. NOT drawn from taxonomies/object_class_v1.json (C12) — this side channel predates and does not yet require that harmonisation. Do not assume the two vocabularies agree.

confidence.description: Detector confidence for the 2-D box this observation was back-projected from.

pose_dof.description: Honesty field, not a preference: a single-view 2-D box + depth back-projection structurally observes POSITION ONLY (3 DoF) — it cannot observe orientation. pose_dof MUST be 3 with quat_wxyz null unless a real orientation estimator produced this record, in which case pose_dof MUST be 6 with quat_wxyz populated. Never emit a placeholder quaternion to make a 3-DoF observation look like 6-DoF — that is exactly the failure mode this field exists to make impossible to hide.

position_m.description: [x, y, z] in metres, in the pose_frame (map).

quat_wxyz.description: Orientation as [w, x, y, z] (scalar FIRST — matches Mnesis-Daedalus's own MuJoCo/scene.types.py quaternion convention; this is a deliberate departure from C12 pose.q's scalar-LAST [x,y,z,w], not an inconsistency to be quietly reconciled). MUST be null when pose_dof is 3. MUST be a unit quaternion (4 finite numbers, |q| = 1 within tolerance) when pose_dof is 6.

depth_m.description: Depth used for the back-projection, metres, along the optical axis (not radial). Diagnostic — kept for provenance, not for re-deriving position_m.

box_xyxy.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] source-frame pixel box the observation was measured from. x1 < x2 and y1 < y2 (Detection2D convention).

width_m.description: Metric extent of the box in the image plane AT depth_m — one of two honest 2-D measurements, not a fitted 3-D bounding box (same discipline as perception.detector.MapDetection.width_m).

height_m.description: Metric extent of the box in the image plane at depth_m — see width_m.
